Discussed traditional ways of living with nature: Bishnoi, sacred groves and Chipko.
Dev explained that roots hold soil, helping water stay in the ground and reach trees.
Dev identified Bishnoi practices of protecting trees and animals.
Dev explained that sacred groves are forest areas left undisturbed.
Teach-back was not yet complete.
end.parentNote: Asha practised examples of how communities protect nature and used questions and a drawing to connect roots, soil and water. Dev first wondered how trees could help save water, then explained that roots hold the soil so water does not run away. At home, ask Dev to make a three-part picture showing a tree’s roots, soil and water, and label one Bishnoi practice and one sacred-grove practice.
